overview_description.description: A learning platform to increase a freelancer's productivity by utilizing AI tools in their work. Jobescape is an online learning platform that focuses on teaching users how to build AI agents and use them for freelancing and digital work. It offers step-by-step courses, certifications, and tools to help beginners develop AI automation skills, create workflows, and start earning through remote AI-based services and freelance opportunities.

product.name: Freelance Copywriter Course
product.description: A course teaching persuasive writing skills for freelancing, covering headlines, landing pages, ad copy, and email sequences.

product.name: Media Buyer/Facebook Ads Manager Course
product.description: A course on launching, scaling, and optimizing Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns for freelancing with e-commerce and digital brands.

product.name: Social Media Manager Course
product.description: A course on managing and growing social media accounts, including content creation, scheduling, analytics, and trendspotting.

product.name: AI Powered Problem Solver Course
product.description: A course teaching freelancers to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, and Make.com for content generation, automation, and bot building.

product.name: AI Assistants Access
product.description: Access to over 20 AI-powered assistants and bots that help with writing, presentations, idea generation, and creative tasks.

product.name: Personalized Freelancing Learning Plan
product.description: A customized learning path based on individual time, interests, and skill level to guide users in freelancing with AI tools.
